title: Cash Value Terms by Instrument — Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers
content:
For revenue accounting purposes, the value of **Crestline Flight Credits and Travel Vouchers** leaves a credit as cash only on the terms each instrument carries. Two terms decide whether cash can be paid at all: whether an accepted voucher may later be exchanged for cash, and whether a credit issued for a Crestline-cancelled flight or in place of a refund may be refunded in cash on request. Where a cash exchange is permitted, the window and the percentage of remaining value paid are stated. Every instrument states the business days within which a cash refund of credit value is processed.

| Instrument | Cash exchange of an accepted voucher | Cash-exchange window (calendar days after issue) | Cash paid on exchange (percent of remaining value) | Involuntary-origin credit refundable in cash | Cash refund processed within (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Residual Travel Credit | No | 0 | 0 | No | 7 |
| Crestline Flight Credit | No | 0 | 0 | Yes | 7 |
| Crestline Trip Credit | No | 0 | 0 | Yes | 7 |
| Crestline Service Recovery eCertificate | No | 0 | 0 | No | 7 |
| Crestline Disruption Voucher | No | 0 | 0 | No | 7 |
| Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher | Yes | 30 | 80 | No | 7 |

## Accounting notes

1. Only the Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher carries a cash exchange: within 30 calendar days after issue, at 80 percent of the remaining value.
2. The Crestline Flight Credit and the Crestline Trip Credit are the instruments whose involuntary-origin credits are refundable in cash on request.
3. The processing period is 7 business days on every instrument.

## Hypothetical figure

On a Crestline Denied Boarding Voucher with a remaining value of 312.45 US dollars, 80 percent of the remaining value is 249.96 US dollars once rounded to the cent. The balance is an example only.
